precision: FP32/complex64 candidate; independent FP64 reference only; no AMP/TF32/fast-math
numerical_gate: All affected output and VJP tensors meet test/numerical_policy.py normal/weak budgets; no post-hoc threshold changes
semantics: Keep routing, broadcast reductions, shared-input gradient accumulation order, per-call differentiable kernel FFT, higher-order ATen fallback, streams and graph lifetime
performance_scope: Complete forward plus requested VJPs including all copies, dispatch and synchronization; separate complete model Adam steps; profiler not used for timing
performance_protocol: 5 warmups; at least 9 alternating AB/BA rounds with 10 calls each; a second independent repeat for any promotion. Restore identical initial parameters and Adam state outside each model timing round and use identical data sequences for each route; no input/hook/profiler work hidden outside one route only.
performance_gate: At least 1.03x median complete-call speedup in the claimed target on both runs, positive paired improvement in at least ceil(rounds*7/9) rounds; no material slowdown above 2% on the claimed deployment workloads. A training optimization must additionally show positive full-model B4 Adam-step improvement in both runs.
quality_gate: Frozen weights/data, at least 3 seeds x 3 optimizer steps on an actually active candidate shape; every output/loss/gradient/parameter/optimizer tensor must be finite and satisfy atol=rtol=3e-5 model smoke. Operator tensors separately meet independent FP64 budgets. Assert expected active call count per model forward: 140 for both prior pointwise directions, 70 if only one direction is admitted. This is regression coverage, not convergence proof.
commit_policy: Commit one passing production change at a time, with reproducible tools/tests and compact evidence. Keep rejected experiments and original failure records without relabelling.
gpu_policy: Only the root agent runs GPU work; CPU-only source review and harness work may run in parallel.
